About Me

I am a Ph.D. student in Human-Centred Vision Lab at School of Computer Science in University of Birmingham, UK. I am supervised by Prof. Hyung Jin Chang and Prof. Aleš Leonardis. Before my Ph.D., I graduated from Shanghai Jiao Tong University, supervised by Prof. Xu Zhao, and was a member of Computer Vision Lab.
